note: SHARED TS <-> SQL VECTORS for the ADR 0133 person-authority decision.
This file is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for both halves of the mirror:
1. src/lib/users/person-scope.ts        -> personScopeAllows            (TS)
2. app.can_administer_person_for        -> the SQL twin (ADR 0161)      (SQL)
WHY IT EXISTS. ADR 0133 D4 refused to build a SQL twin at all, and one of its stated
reasons was that a mirror is a DRIFT LIABILITY. ADR 0155 G11 reversed the refusal;
ADR 0161 records that reversal. Creating the mirror without the drift control would
accept precisely the liability the original prohibition warned about, so Architecture
Rule 3 now genuinely attaches to this pair. Two independently-authored case lists
drift SILENTLY -- one list, consumed by both, cannot.
CONSUMERS:
- src/lib/users/person-scope-vectors.test.ts  drives personScopeAllows with these
rows AND asserts the generated .psql is in sync with this file's sha256.
- supabase/tests/vectors/person_scope_vectors.psql  (GENERATED by
scripts/gen-person-scope-vectors.mjs), loaded by pgTAP 384 section 9, which
materialises each footprint as real rows and drives the SQL predicate.
HOSPITAL KEYS are abstract. The SQL side binds H1/H2 to two real hospitals of the
same organisation; the TS side treats them as opaque strings. Two hospitals are
sufficient and NOT a shortcut: the whole INTERSECTION/SUBSET distinction is visible
in the {H1,H2} x administered {H1} shape, and a three-hospital case exercises the
same two predicates with a longer array.
THE SHAPE THAT MATTERS is S4. A sole-footprint person satisfies BOTH bounds, so every
sole-footprint vector passes under either one and can never detect a swap. Only a
person whose footprint EXCEEDS the caller's coverage separates them.

shapes.S1: empty footprint, caller administers H1 -- the vacuous-subset inversion pin
shapes.S2: sole footprint {H1}, caller administers {H1} -- both bounds agree
shapes.S3: sole footprint {H1}, caller administers {H2} -- no overlap at all
shapes.S4: spanning {H1,H2}, caller administers {H1} -- THE differential: the bounds disagree
shapes.S7: sole footprint {H1} + a non-commission-tier seat -- D2 overrides every bound
shapes.S8: spanning {H1,H2} + a tier seat, caller administers BOTH -- D2 beats full coverage
